question: After the merged Web UI session-thread work and `/name` command, should #54397 remain the broad tracker for residual TUI, CLI, metadata, and import/export scope, or should maintainers split those slices into narrower canonical issues?
rationale: Current main solves important pieces, but the remaining behavior crosses product UX, protocol, CLI/TUI, and persisted state boundaries that should not be queued as one automated fix.

options.title: Keep Broad Residual Tracker
options.body: Keep #54397 open as the umbrella while linking narrower implementation issues and PRs for each residual slice.

options.title: Split And Close Umbrella
options.body: Create or designate separate canonical issues for TUI, CLI lifecycle, metadata, and import/export, then close #54397 once those links preserve the remaining scope.

options.title: Declare Current Web Scope Enough
options.body: Close #54397 as sufficiently satisfied by current Web UI and chat naming work, explicitly leaving TUI/CLI/metadata/import-export out of scope.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Residual Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep #54397 open as the umbrella while linking narrower implementation issues and PRs for each residual slice.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current session-thread foundation and the category grouping follow-up, making them the clearest owner for the remaining product-scope decision.
